what: how the restaurants sell, how their guests rate them and how many guests they keep

semantic_models.name: daily_sales
semantic_models.description: One row for each restaurant on each day it had an order.

dimensions.name: city
dimensions.description: The city the restaurant is in.

dimensions.name: cuisine
dimensions.description: The kind of food the restaurant serves.

semantic_models.name: restaurant_scorecard
semantic_models.description: One row for each restaurant, as of the day of the newest order.

dimensions.name: city
dimensions.description: The city the restaurant is in.

dimensions.name: cuisine
dimensions.description: The kind of food the restaurant serves.

measures.name: rating_total
measures.description: The stars of all the reviews.

semantic_models.name: customer_churn
semantic_models.description: One row for each month after the first month with an order, up to the last month with an order, counted in the month a customer stops ordering.

measures.name: churned_sum
measures.description: Customers with an order in the month before and none in this month.

measures.name: start_sum
measures.description: Customers with an order in the month before.

measures.name: active_sum
measures.description: Customers with an order in the month.

metrics.name: revenue
metrics.description: What the orders cost, added up over the restaurants and the days that are asked for.

metrics.name: orders
metrics.description: How many orders the restaurants took.

metrics.name: avg_ticket
metrics.description: What one order costs on average, which is the revenue over the orders, and not the average of the daily averages.

metrics.name: avg_rating
metrics.description: The stars that the customers gave on average, from 1 to 5, over all the reviews of the restaurants that are asked for.

metrics.name: churn_rate
metrics.description: The share of the customers who ordered last month that did not order this month. A month that starts with no customers has no churn rate.

metrics.name: active_customers
metrics.description: How many customers ordered in the month.
